description: This Java interface defines configuration parameters for monitoring loggers within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including capacities, maximum log size, log duration, and check intervals.

classes.name: MonitoringLoggerConfig
classes.description: Interface for configuration related to monitoring loggers, providing methods to retrieve success and failure capacities, maximum log size, log duration, and check intervals.

classes.name: MonitoringLoggerConfig.MonitoringLoggerConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of configuration path expressions and default values for monitoring logger settings, implementing KnownConfigValue interface.

methods.name: successCapacity
methods.description: Returns the number of success logs stored for each category and type.

methods.name: failureCapacity
methods.description: Returns the number of failure logs stored for each category and type.

methods.name: maxLogSizeInBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of log entries in their JSON form.

methods.name: logDuration
methods.description: Returns how long logs will remain enabled after being activated.

methods.name: loggingActiveCheckInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval at which the system checks if the logging timeframe has been exceeded and logs need to be disabled.
